You plan to visit 10 European cities for 23 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You would like to visit Lyon for 3 days. You would like to visit Paris for 5 days. You plan to stay in Riga for 2 days. You plan to stay in Berlin for 2 days. You are going to attend a wedding in Berlin between day 1 and day 2. You plan to stay in Stockholm for 3 days. From day 20 to day 22, there is a annual show you want to attend in Stockholm. You plan to stay in Zurich for 5 days. You want to spend 2 days in Nice. You have to attend a workshop in Nice between day 12 and day 13. You plan to stay in Seville for 3 days. You want to spend 3 days in Milan. You would like to visit Naples for 4 days.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Paris and Stockholm, Seville and Paris, Naples and Zurich, Nice and Riga, Berlin and Milan, Paris and Zurich, Paris and Nice, Milan and Paris, Milan and Riga, Paris and Lyon, Milan and Naples, Paris and Riga, Berlin and Stockholm, Stockholm and Riga, Nice and Zurich, Milan and Zurich, Lyon and Nice, Zurich and Stockholm, Zurich and Riga, Berlin and Naples, Milan and Stockholm, Berlin and Zurich, Milan and Seville, Paris and Naples, Berlin and Riga, Nice and Stockholm, Berlin and Paris, Nice and Naples, Berlin and Nice.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 23 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

Below is one valid solution. In this plan you start the trip in Berlin (with the wedding between Day 1 and Day 2) and later hit Nice on Day 12–13 (so that the Nice workshop is attended) and finish your Stockholm visit on Day 20–22 (to catch the annual show). Notice that when you fly, the day on which you take off counts for both the departing and arriving cities. One valid itinerary (using only flights that exist between consecutive cities) is as follows:

• Start in Berlin for 2 days (Day 1–2).  
• Fly on Day 2 from Berlin to Milan (3 days; Days 2–4).  
• Fly on Day 4 from Milan to Seville (3 days; Days 4–6).  
• Fly on Day 6 from Seville to Paris (5 days; Days 6–10).  
• Fly on Day 10 from Paris to Lyon (3 days; Days 10–12).  
• Fly on Day 12 from Lyon to Nice (2 days; Days 12–13).  
  • The Nice workshop falls on Day 12–13.  
• Fly on Day 13 from Nice to Naples (4 days; Days 13–16).  
• Fly on Day 16 from Naples to Zurich (5 days; Days 16–20).  
• Fly on Day 20 from Zurich to Stockholm (3 days; Days 20–22).  
  • The Stockholm annual show is during Day 20–22.  
• Fly on Day 22 from Stockholm to Riga (2 days; Days 22–23).

This complete sequence uses 9 flights (so each “shared” day is counted twice across cities) and the total trip spans exactly 23 days.

In the requested JSON format the plan is output as follows:

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-2",   "place": "Berlin"},
    {"day_range": "Day 2-4",   "place": "Milan"},
    {"day_range": "Day 4-6",   "place": "Seville"},
    {"day_range": "Day 6-10",  "place": "Paris"},
    {"day_range": "Day 10-12", "place": "Lyon"},
    {"day_range": "Day 12-13", "place": "Nice"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-16", "place": "Naples"},
    {"day_range": "Day 16-20", "place": "Zurich"},
    {"day_range": "Day 20-22", "place": "Stockholm"},
    {"day_range": "Day 22-23", "place": "Riga"}
  ]
}

Each leg has a direct flight (for example, “Berlin–Milan,” “Milan–Seville,” “Seville–Paris,” “Paris–Lyon,” “Lyon–Nice,” “Nice–Naples,” “Naples–Zurich,” “Zurich–Stockholm,” “Stockholm–Riga”) according to the list provided. All scheduled requirements are met and the overall trip lasts 23 days.
